capabilities: Import Granola meeting notes as Markdown files with frontmatter
Schedule auto-sync or trigger manual syncs via ribbon and command palette
Tag and link meeting attendees in frontmatter
Add today's meetings to daily notes (core and Periodic Notes)
Filter synced notes by Granola folder and creation date
disambiguation: Not a two-way vault sync; it imports Granola meeting notes one-way into Obsidian.
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly) because it reads Granola credentials from the OS; formerly named 'Granola Sync' with a changed plugin ID; the README documents exactly which files, subprocesses, and hosts it touches and warns to back up the vault before using the experimental vault-wide duplicate search.
problem: Granola meeting notes live in the Granola app, so getting them into Obsidian means copying them by hand or losing them outside the vault.

relations.evidence: The plugin now supports the Periodic Notes plugin for enhanced daily note management
This plugin reads your Granola notes from the official Granola API

requires.name: Granola Business or Enterprise plan (for API key mode)

summary: Granola integration that imports your Granola AI meeting notes into the vault on a schedule or manually, with templates, attendee tags, and daily note updates.
